Record notes

Writing Quality Studio brings eleven writing skills together for clear prose, source-grounded communication, authentic voice, technical instructions and grant work. Critical Compass remains owned by Reasoning Toolkit.

This release includes complete first-party and licensed methods, local helpers, synthetic examples, per-file provenance and scoped notices. Optional publisher methods and connected services require separate access.

The 275-file package passed native Codex and Claude candidate installation with exact cache parity, 28 helper unit tests, citation smoke tests and package validation. Sample tasks covered factual editing, voice intake, procedural order and grant intake. Citation samples exposed two failures that informed the included unknown-source rule; a fresh Opus holdout passed. These are bounded checks, not a guarantee of model output quality. See the repository compatibility notes for tested states and limitations.

Install from the Working Tools marketplace or download the ZIP below. SHA256SUMS and the file manifest verify these release bytes.
